sources.title: Afghanistan: travel and security advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Federal Foreign Office country guidance is addressed to German nationals, was current as of 22 July 2026, and directly states the Afghan entry-visa requirement and pre-entry application timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: vor der Einreise bei einer afghanischen Auslandsvertretung wie der Botschaft der Islamischen Republik Afghanistan beantragt werden muss.

unresolved.reason: Germany says a visa must be requested before travel at an Afghan foreign mission, but its linked mission endpoint is unavailable and no current Afghan official source verifies a functioning ordinary German-passport visitor issuance route or timing.
